target.title: fix(googlechat): cap approval binding registries
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two unbounded in-process Maps in the Google Chat approval flow:

1. **`approvalCardBindings`** — maps `cardId → {messageId, spaceId, agentRunId}` for every in-flight approval card. On an instance handling many simultaneous approval requests this Map grows without bound.
2. **`manualApprovalFollowupSuppressions`** — tracks `{spaceId, agentRunId}` pairs for which a follow-up message should be suppressed. Same unbounded growth pattern.

## Why This Change Was Made

Applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` (from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime`) immediately after every `.set` call on both Maps, each capped at **1 024 entries** (LRU: oldest binding removed first).

A cap of 1 024 comfortably exceeds the number of simultaneously in-flight approval cards in any realistic deployment; evicted bindings simply cannot be resolved, which is the same failure mode as a gateway restart.

**Changed files:** 2 files, +83 lines

```
extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.ts       +14
extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.test.ts  +69
```

## User Impact

Operators running Google Chat channels with high approval-card volume on long-lived gateways get bounded memory. Behavior is unchanged for the first 1 024 simultaneous in-flight approval cards.

## Evidence

**New regression tests (run on `fix/googlechat-cap-approval-bindings`):**

- `approval-card-actions.test.ts` — *"evicts oldest approval card bindings once the cache exceeds its cap"*: registers 1 025 card bindings, verifies `getGoogleChatApprovalCardBinding` returns `undefined` for card 0 and the correct binding for card 1 024.
- `approval-card-actions.test.ts` — *"evicts oldest manual approval follow-up suppressions once the cache exceeds its cap"*: inserts 1 025 suppression entries, verifies entry 0 is evicted while entry 1 024 is still present.

**Local test run (`extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.test.ts`):**

```
pnpm node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-messaging.config.ts \
  extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.test.ts

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  6 passed (6)
  Duration  200ms
```
